title: AxisHelper debug axes
summary: Adds AxisHelper (RGB X/Y/Z line-list axes, default length 1000, alfrid DrawAxis parity). Exports createSceneUniformPipelineLayout so AxisHelper and Draw share one viewProj bind group. DrawOptions.layout for explicit pipeline layouts. camera-orbit draws axes then triangle.
